20261118-math-g03.material: [E3 Gingo ti Diko-koli] Hundango gingo na ndo ti Multiplication na division, fraction, mesure, figure, données. A-nambara ti kekereke use $A$ na $B$ asara $A + 2B = 24$. Tongana $A$ awara kota ngere ti lo, ngere ti $B$ ayeke nye?
20261118-math-g03.thinking.0: Multiplication na division, fraction, mesure, figure, données
20261118-math-g03.thinking.1: Bibe ti ndara na gingo nda ti ye
20261118-math-g03.s.s1.prompt: [E3 Gingo ti Diko-koli] Hundango gingo na ndo ti Multiplication na division, fraction, mesure, figure, données. A-nambara ti kekereke use $A$ na $B$ asara $A + 2B = 24$. Tongana $A$ awara kota ngere ti lo, ngere ti $B$ ayeke nye?
20261118-math-g03.s.s1.explain:
Tamba 1: Salango equation ni afa $A = 24 - 2B$.
Tamba 2: Teti $A, B \ge 1$ ayeke a-nambara ti kekereke, $2B$ adoit ti duti kete si $A$ aga kota.
Tamba 3: Kete nambara ti kekereke ayeke $B = 1$.
Tamba 4: Na ndo so, $A = 24 - 2(1) = 22$ (kota mingi), ni la $B = 1$.
20261118-math-g03.s.s1.hint.0: Kete ngere ti nambara ti kekereke teti $B$ ayeke $1$.
20261118-math-g03.s.s1.hint.1: Teti $A = 24 - 2B$, $A$ aga kota tongana $B$ ayeke kete.

Bongbi ti a-nambara ti kekereke ota so alondo ambaï ayeke $3S$, na koli ti kete ni na kota ni zia da $1$ ayeke $T^2$. Tongana $S = 15$, kota nambara ni ayeke so wa?
20261121-math-g03-1.thinking.0: Multiplication na division, fraction, mesure, figure, données
20261121-math-g03-1.thinking.1: Bibe ti ndara na gingo nda ti ye
20261121-math-g03-1.s.s1.prompt: [E3 Gingo ti Diko-koli (Ti kota)] Kpale ti gingo nda ni so akpengba na lekengo Multiplication na division, fraction, mesure, figure, données. Bongbi ti a-nambara ti kekereke ota so alondo ambaï ayeke $3S$, na koli ti kete ni na kota ni zia da $1$ ayeke $T^2$. Tongana $S = 15$, kota nambara ni ayeke so wa?
20261121-math-g03-1.s.s1.explain:
Tamba 1: Mungo a-nambara tongana $n-1, n, n+1$, bongbi ni ayeke $3n = 3S \Rightarrow n = S = 15$.
Tamba 2: A-nambara ota ni ayeke $14, 15, 16$.
Tamba 3: Kota nambara ni ayeke $16$.
Tamba 4: Bango ni: $(14 \times 16) + 1 = 224 + 1 = 225 = 15^2$.
20261121-math-g03-1.s.s1.hint.0: Mungo a-nambara so alondo ambaï $n-1, n, n+1$ afa bongbi ti $3n$.
20261121-math-g03-1.s.s1.hint.1: Nambara ti popo ni ayeke $n = S = 15$.
